reason: The plugin is a conversation-header enhancement that lets users open the current workspace in locally detected editors. Evidence shows a dual host/client design: the host scans installed editors and exposes routes, while the web client renders a dropdown action in the session header. Its primary user-facing role is launching external editors from the UI, with local process spawning and path handling as supporting behavior.

summaries.zh: 该插件在会话头部提供“在编辑器中打开”下拉菜单，扫描本机已安装编辑器并可一键打开当前会话对应的工作区。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an “Open in Editor” dropdown in the session header to scan local editors and open the current workspace in a selected local editor.

capabilities: open selected workspace in external editor
provide host-side web endpoints for editor actions
perform local workspace path validation before launch
open selected workspace in external editor
